risks.data_migration: 0011 is additive: one new table, no column added to or removed from an existing table, no data rewritten. The downgrade drops only that table, so 0010's fourteen seeded categories and every service.category_id survive. Both FKs cascade from their parents, so provider/category deletion cannot orphan a declaration.
risks.security_privacy: No new endpoint, no new admin surface and no new authentication path: the mismatch artefact is an ordinary review_item consumed by F007's existing, already-authenticated review queue. evidence_url is operator-declared configuration, never user input, and is never fetched by the application - the offline posture (Q3-A) is unchanged and no test opens a socket. No secret is introduced; detect-secrets is re-run after git add.
risks.portability: No new runtime or test dependency (Q6-A): stdlib, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic and the already-installed toolchain only. No Redis; PostgreSQL stays the only mandatory stateful service. The CHECK expressions use plain SQL (btrim) with no extension. amd64/arm64 unaffected.
risks.zero_cost_safety: This slice STRENGTHENS the Z0 posture rather than relaxing it. 'not_offered' can now only ever be an evidenced human DECLARATION and is never inferred from an empty query result; the derivation refuses to assert 'offered_no_z0' when any published offer is unclassified (it degrades to 'incomplete'), and refuses 'verified_free' when evidence is stale or contradicted. An undeclared pair is reported 'unknown'. The Q9-A floor makes an evidence-free provider YAML unloadable, so a provider can never be onboarded as a wall of guesses.
risks.immutability: offer_version stays immutable and append-only: nothing here writes offer, offer_version or quota. Coverage is declared structural metadata, absent from the publisher's stable material facts, so it cannot alter a content_hash or mint a version.
risks.regression: The main regression surface is the category-matrix contract change: 'no_free_tier' becomes 'offered_no_z0' and an undeclared pair now reports 'unknown' instead of the old inferred 'not_offered'. Existing matrix assertions are updated to assert on derived_state so they stay meaningful rather than being weakened. Making coverage: mandatory changes provider-config loading; the only inline provider YAMLs are in tests/unit/test_config_system.py and the single shipped Cloudflare example, both updated. Tests are written to go RED if the not_offered guess is re-introduced or the floor is neutered.
risks.supply_chain: No new npm or Python dependency; pip-audit, npm audit and detect-secrets stay green. Any install would go through the Microsoft feed proxies (pip https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple; NuGet https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/nuget/v3/index.json) - none is needed.
risks.concurrency: S1 (0010) and S3 (fixture harness + profile registration seam) are already merged, so there is no concurrent sibling. Six Wave-3 provider slices run on top of this slice, so apps/api/app/ingest/adapters/** is left byte-stable and the config schema addition is purely additive per provider file. Live-run isolation uses POSTGRES_PORT=55432 API_PORT=8010 WEB_PORT=8090 and compose project -p ftatlas_f008_s2, torn down with down --volumes.

notes: Orchestrator directed F008 Slice S2: explicit provider x category coverage state, migration 0011_provider_category_coverage. The decisive probes are (a) re-introducing the 'published == 0 => not_offered' guess must turn a test RED, (b) deleting one of the fourteen YAML coverage entries must fail config load, (c) a fourteen-entry all-'unknown' block must be a HARD failure, and (d) no derived_state/derived_at column may exist anywhere (Q11). Hard constraints: no new dependency, no Redis, no live network, no credentialed provider APIs, no secrets, no FTS, adapters byte-stable. F008 passes stays false; do NOT merge; do NOT flip passes; then STOP for a fresh-context Level 2 evaluation.

BUILDER-DISCLOSED JUDGEMENT CALLS (the brief did not specify these): (1) the derivation PRECEDENCE is honesty-first - conflicting > stale > verified_free > incomplete > offered_no_z0 > unknown - rather than the brief's incidental listing order, so a pending contradiction or stale evidence is never masked by an optimistic free claim; (2) the effective/displayed state is 'unknown' when undeclared, 'conflicting' when declared and derived materially disagree, otherwise the declared state, with derived_state always exposed alongside; (3) derived == 'unknown' is never a material mismatch, so an evidence-backed declaration may legitimately run ahead of the ingest pipeline without spamming the review queue; (4) a pair is treated as stale when ANY source backing it is beyond its schedule window (conservative); (5) the review-item WRITER lives in apps/api/app/ingest/reconcile_coverage.py rather than in read_api/coverage.py so the documented 'the read API never writes' invariant is preserved.
